items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Duke several times after that as replacement for Johnny Hodges.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's '34. After that, back in

the '40s, I worked with Duke several times after that as replacement for Johnny Hodges. Then I also worked a replacement for Hilton Jefferson on the eastern coast with Duke. And just various times. I was his built-in replacement. Anytime anybody -- anything happened to any of the people that played alto or thereabouts, if I was anywhere within hailing distance, he'd always call me. We had a little mutual admiration society and our own little particular turn-on that we did to each other.

Tell me about that. You told me that because you had worked with Duke in the past, Duke knew that you could step right in and take over any part (inaudible) there and when Johnny Hodges left in '51, you said Duke called you, right?
